jobs.title: Chief AI Officer
jobs.description:
Axial Search is a specialist executive search firm built for one kind of hire: leaders who help organizations navigate AI transformation. Apply today to express your interest in roles like this one.

Visit our website to learn more about our process and explore free tools for your job search, including our live job market dashboard with salary, skills and hiring trend data from thousands of AI transformation roles.

What The Market Looks Like

Chief AI Officer roles in Canada remain sparse but growing—we've tracked 9 executive-level AI strategy postings across the country over the last six months, concentrated in Ontario, Quebec, and British Columbia. Technology, financial services, and professional services firms are leading hires. Compensation for this cohort ranges from $180k to $330k annually. The strongest candidates combine deep technical fluency with board-level communication skills, proven experience scaling AI initiatives across large organizations, and the ability to translate business strategy into executable AI roadmaps.

Job Responsibilities

Own the development and execution of the organization's AI strategy, including technology roadmap, capability building, and integration across business units
Lead the assessment, evaluation, and deployment of AI tools and platforms to drive competitive advantage and operational efficiency
Build and scale high-performing teams—data scientists, ML engineers, and AI specialists—while fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous learning
Partner with C-suite and board members to translate AI opportunities into business outcomes, manage risk, and secure investment and resources
Drive cross-functional collaboration to identify use cases, pilot programs, and full-scale implementations across the enterprise
Establish governance frameworks, ethical guardrails, and compliance standards for responsible AI deployment
Represent the organization externally—engage with industry peers, vendors, and thought leaders to stay ahead of market trends

Candidate Requirements

12+ years of experience building and scaling AI, machine learning, or data science capabilities, with at least 5 years in a leadership or executive role
Proven track record taking AI initiatives from strategy through implementation and measuring business impact at scale
Strong technical foundation—hands-on knowledge of ML/AI architectures, generative AI, and modern data platforms; you don't need to code daily, but you speak the language fluently
Experience leading and recruiting technical talent, building organizational structures, and embedding AI literacy across non-technical teams
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical audiences and influence executive and board-level decision-making
Understanding of AI governance, ethics, risk, and compliance in regulated or risk-sensitive industries

jobs.title: Senior Technical Director, DataEdge Strategy & Architecture
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Technical Director defines and drives the technical strategy across the DataEdge portfolio. In close partnership with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and executive leadership, this role aligns product roadmaps, platform investments, and architectural decisions with customer needs, business objectives, and Rocket’s strategy to become a platform company.

The DataEdge portfolio includes Rocket’s data integration, replication, synchronization, virtualization, and data intelligence solutions. It helps customers unlock enterprise data across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments by making trusted data available where it is needed. As AI adoption accelerates, DataEdge delivers trusted, connected, and actionable information to the applications, platforms, models, agents, and intelligent business processes that power modern digital enterprises.

This role will evolve the portfolio into an integrated platform through cloud-native architecture, shared services, AI-enabled innovation, and cross-product collaboration. The Senior Technical Director will also work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, identify shared opportunities, and align architecture and investment decisions across portfolios. Success requires technical leadership and the ability to build alignment and shared ownership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Partner with Product Management to define the DataEdge platform strategy and translate business priorities into a shared, cross-product technical roadmap.
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture, balancing product needs with DataEdge platform objectives and the shared technical direction of the Data Modernization business unit.
Work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, align investments, and identify shared platform opportunities.
Drive reusable services, APIs, frameworks, and common platform capabilities while consolidating overlapping technologies.
Define cloud-native strategies for deployment, configuration, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence.
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI platform capabilities, intelligent automation, MCP, and agentic systems that create measurable customer value and competitive differentiation.
Represent the DataEdge technology vision internally and externally. Use customer input, industry trends, analyst perspectives, emerging technologies, and competitive insight to shape strategy and investment priorities.
Shape DataEdge’s role in the broader data, analytics, and AI ecosystem through technology partnerships, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Raise engineering effectiveness across the portfolio by advancing AI-enabled development, testing, documentation, modernization, and delivery practices.
Lead architecture reviews, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and mentor Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.

Required Qualifications:

12+ years of software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership experience.
Proven experience defining architecture and technology strategy across multiple enterprise products or platforms and contributing to strategy across a broader business or portfolio.
Strong expertise in LLMs, agentic systems, retrieval architectures, enterprise AI integration, responsible AI patterns, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP.
Demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and modern software delivery.
Experience building shared platforms, services, APIs, or reusable frameworks and leading technology consolidation.
Successful partnership with Product Management on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work with peer senior technical leaders to shape strategy, resolve cross-portfolio tradeoffs, align technical investments, and influence without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to shape ecosystem strategy across enterprise data, analytics, and AI, including work with customers, technology partners, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, including with executive leaders, with demonstrated experience mentoring Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IS, or related technical discipline.

Rocket Software Inc. is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Rocket Software Inc. is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

At Rocket Software, we believe AI is a critical enabler of innovation and productivity. All Rocketeers are expected to actively leverage AI-powered tools and technologies, where appropriate, to enhance efficiency, improve decision-making, and deliver greater impact in their roles. Embracing continuous learning and the responsible use of AI is an essential part of how we work.

As part of our commitment to a safe and trustworthy workplace, we include background and reference checks in our hiring process.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Site Technology Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description

The future is what you make it.

Join a team that designs, develops, and integrates highly complex systems within Honeywell Business Technologies. You will be integral in creating system solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. You will be involved in every aspect of the system’s life cycle, from the front end of business development through product end of life.

As On-site Technology Leader, you will manage existing technologies and ensure that there is ongoing system planning, support and field teams are following best practices. This position will also be complemented with a technical sales function, presenting innovative technical solutions to the client, this will keep the client and systems current and leverage new technologies while improving Honeywell's bottom line.

You will need to lead / organize successful on-site installation, servicing and repair of complex equipment and systems without direct supervision. You will coordinate the development of detailed work instructions and amend any outdated or incorrect instructions with help of Engineering teams. You will make improvements to training guides and documentation also develop detailed life cycle plans for all onsite technology that Honeywell is responsible for. You will lead continuous improvement initiatives in the field to quickly fix any administrative difficulties relating to delivery and installation of proper equipment. Person must be innovative, able to follow policy and willing to learn and drive new Honeywell technical offerings.

In this role, you will work on-site at our customer location at 1929 Ogilvie Road, Gloucester, Ottawa
.

Must be eligible to obtain Top Secret SIGNET Government clearance as well as CGP clearance.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Project coordination
Developing system road maps
Project oversight
Requirements analysis
Managing lifecycle design and deployments
Requirements decomposition
Systems design
Model based development system design
Systems integration
Customer interaction
Budget/schedule responsibility
Track meetings and provide required reporting.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

College diploma in a Computer/ Technology related program
Minimum 5 years of field industry experience working with information technology (IT) or Operational technology (OT).
Minimum 2 years’ experience with technical sales or business development
Ability to obtain Top Secret SIGNET Government clearance

WE VALUE

Previous technical/installation experience in building automation
Previous technical/installation experience in building Fire and Security
Business development, ability to educate clients on Honeywell systems and products.
Strong knowledge, understanding, and implementation of Windows Operating systems.
Ability to manage virtual environments.
Computer science
Bilingual (French & English)
Previous customer service experience
Good written and oral communication
Ability to follow instructions and identify mistakes
Good presentation skills
Networking Experience
Database administration
Knowledge of ICT/Cybersecurity fundamentals, Intermediate to Advanced computer skills
Demonstrated experience in organizing and directing work activities according to priorities, and to meet deadlines involving multiple systems projects and vendors.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative and creative solutions in a complex multiple system environment.
Previous exposure to a site base, construction environment
Project management experience.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date. However, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting date October 9 th , 2026.

The annual base salary range for this position is $95,000 to $110,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants for employment with Honeywell will be considered without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity, and pregnancy) disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities under the Ontario Human Rights Code.

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director, Canada
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ENTERPRISE SALES DIRECTOR, CANADA

The Starlink Enterprise Sales team is hiring a senior, entrepreneurial leader to build and own the full go-to-market strategy for Starlink across Canada. This is a greenfield opportunity to establish Starlink’s enterprise presence in the Canadian market from the ground up. Starlink brings an unprecedented opportunity to deliver high-performance connectivity to Canada’s largest enterprises, critical infrastructure, and organizations.

This highly senior Director role will have full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions in Canada. The primary focus is Top Fortune / large enterprise business, followed by SLED and government opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems, building robust channel ecosystems, and establishing high-level relationships with leading Canadian enterprises. You will build the strategy, the team, the partnerships, and the revenue engine.

Responsibilities

Build and own the complete go-to-market strategy for Starlink Enterprise in Canada from scratch, with primary focus on large enterprise and Top Fortune accounts, followed by SLED and government
Own full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions across the Canadian market
Establish and scale strategic relationships with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations, key ecosystems, and channel partners
Build a robust multi-tier channel and partner ecosystem to accelerate market coverage and growth
Identify, develop, and close large opportunities with Canada’s top enterprises, while also pursuing high-value civil, provincial, municipal, education, and broader government opportunities as a secondary priority
Recruit, build, and lead a high-performing Canadian sales and channel team
Consistently meet and exceed revenue targets by identifying high-impact opportunities and closing complex deals
Develop, champion, and defend alternative go-to-market and partnership strategies internally
Partner closely with market access, government affairs, finance, legal, product, and engineering teams
Gather market and customer requirements and collaborate with product and engineering to shape Starlink offerings for the Canadian enterprise market
Represent Starlink at key Canadian industry, enterprise, and government conferences and events

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree
12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise sales, business development, or sales leadership (ideally with significant Canadian market experience)

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven track record of building a market, GTM strategy, and sales/channel organization from the ground up
Deep existing relationships and experience working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems
Strong expertise building and scaling robust channel and partner ecosystems
Extensive experience selling complex technology or connectivity solutions into large enterprise / Top Fortune accounts
Experience with Canadian government, provincial/municipal, and education (SLED) sectors as a secondary strength
Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and full revenue ownership of a regional business
Strong sales track record with consistent achievement of ambitious revenue targets, preferably in satellite, telecommunications, connectivity, or technology solutions
Independently motivated self-starter with exceptional ownership mentality and the ability to build structure in ambiguous environments
Outstanding interpersonal, executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills across business and technical issues
Highly detail-oriented, resilient, and results-driven with excellent customer and partner interface skills
Working knowledge of Starlink’s network infrastructure (or ability to rapidly develop it) sufficient to communicate value to sophisticated enterprise customers and partners
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex external relationships

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 50%+) across Canada to customer and partner locations, as well as to other SpaceX sites as required
Preference for candidates based in Canada or with strong willingness to relocate

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Director of Finance (Controller)
jobs.description:
Director of Finance | Rittal Limited

As a certified Great Place to Work®, Rittal Limited believes that every single team member plays an important role in contributing to our success. We are passionate about creating a fun, high-performance environment where everyone can thrive.

We are the Canadian subsidiary for the world’s leading system supplier for enclosures, power distribution, climate control, IT infrastructure and software and services and are present in more than 90 percent of all sectors worldwide, from government data centres to automotive production lines, manufacturing facilities, mines, greenhouses, ships; even the Oxford University and the Vatican!

What we offer
Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus
Comprehensive health & dental benefits
Disability insurance
Employee & Family Assistance Program
DPSP RRSP matching
Professional development and tuition assistance
Preference for internal promotions
Flexible, hybrid working
Paid time off including sick days and a day off on your birthday

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Director of Finance to lead our accounting and financial operations function. This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity of the company's financial reporting, maintaining strong internal controls, overseeing the accounting team, and supporting organizational decision-making through accurate and timely financial information.
The ideal candidate is a strong accounting leader with a hands-on approach, exceptional knowledge of financial reporting and controls, and experience managing the day-to-day finance operations of a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities
Lead all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, fixed assets, and month-end close processes.
Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Oversee account reconciliations and ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
Maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial records across the organization.
Develop and improve accounting policies, procedures, and controls
Lead the annual financial statement audit and serve as the primary liaison with external auditors.
Ensure compliance with all applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Establish, monitor, and enhance internal control processes to safeguard company assets.
Coordinate corporate tax filings and support relations with external tax advisors.
Identify and mitigate financial and operational risks.
Support the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
Monitor actual results against budget and provide variance analysis.
Prepare management reports and financial insights to support business leaders.
Assist senior leadership with financial planning and operational decision-making
Oversee cash flow management and forecasting.
Monitor working capital and liquidity requirements.
Manage banking relationships and support financing activities.
Ensure effective controls around cash management and disbursements.
Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting and finance team.
Establish departmental goals, performance expectations, and development plans.
Foster a collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.
Drive process efficiencies and finance systems enhancements.

What you bring
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience
At least 3-5 years of experience as a Controller or in a senior accounting leadership role overseeing full-cycle accounting operations
3+ years of people leadership experience.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting standards, internal controls, and audit processes.
Experience leading month-end and year-end close functions.
Advanced Excel and financial systems proficiency.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
CPA designation preferred but not required.
Experience with SAP is an asset.
Experience implementing process improvements and finance automation initiatives

Salary Range
135000 - 160000 / year

Our success depends on our people. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and celebrate the diversity of the communities where we work and live. In accordance with our Accessibility Policy, reasonable accommodations in the hiring process will be provided upon request.

At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The future is what you make it.

Join a team that designs, develops, and integrates highly complex systems within Honeywell Business Technologies. You will be integral in creating system solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. You will be involved in every aspect of the system’s life cycle, from the front end of business development through product end of life.

As On-site Technology Leader, you will manage existing technologies and ensure that there is ongoing system planning, support and field teams are following best practices. This position will also be complemented with a technical sales function, presenting innovative technical solutions to the client, this will keep the client and systems current and leverage new technologies while improving Honeywell's bottom line.

You will need to lead / organize successful on-site installation, servicing and repair of complex equipment and systems without direct supervision. You will coordinate the development of detailed work instructions and amend any outdated or incorrect instructions with help of Engineering teams. You will make improvements to training guides and documentation also develop detailed life cycle plans for all onsite technology that Honeywell is responsible for. You will lead continuous improvement initiatives in the field to quickly fix any administrative difficulties relating to delivery and installation of proper equipment. Person must be innovative, able to follow policy and willing to learn and drive new Honeywell technical offerings.

In this role, you will work on-site at our customer location at 1929 Ogilvie Road, Gloucester, Ottawa
.

Must be eligible to obtain Top Secret SIGNET Government clearance as well as CGP clearance.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Project coordination
Developing system road maps
Project oversight
Requirements analysis
Managing lifecycle design and deployments
Requirements decomposition
Systems design
Model based development system design
Systems integration
Customer interaction
Budget/schedule responsibility
Track meetings and provide required reporting.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

College diploma in a Computer/ Technology related program
Minimum 5 years of field industry experience working with information technology (IT) or Operational technology (OT).
Minimum 2 years’ experience with technical sales or business development
Ability to obtain Top Secret SIGNET Government clearance

WE VALUE

Previous technical/installation experience in building automation
Previous technical/installation experience in building Fire and Security
Business development, ability to educate clients on Honeywell systems and products.
Strong knowledge, understanding, and implementation of Windows Operating systems.
Ability to manage virtual environments.
Computer science
Bilingual (French & English)
Previous customer service experience
Good written and oral communication
Ability to follow instructions and identify mistakes
Good presentation skills
Networking Experience
Database administration
Knowledge of ICT/Cybersecurity fundamentals, Intermediate to Advanced computer skills
Demonstrated experience in organizing and directing work activities according to priorities, and to meet deadlines involving multiple systems projects and vendors.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative and creative solutions in a complex multiple system environment.
Previous exposure to a site base, construction environment
Project management experience.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date. However, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting date October 9 th , 2026.

ENTERPRISE SALES DIRECTOR, CANADA

The Starlink Enterprise Sales team is hiring a senior, entrepreneurial leader to build and own the full go-to-market strategy for Starlink across Canada. This is a greenfield opportunity to establish Starlink’s enterprise presence in the Canadian market from the ground up. Starlink brings an unprecedented opportunity to deliver high-performance connectivity to Canada’s largest enterprises, critical infrastructure, and organizations.

This highly senior Director role will have full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions in Canada. The primary focus is Top Fortune / large enterprise business, followed by SLED and government opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems, building robust channel ecosystems, and establishing high-level relationships with leading Canadian enterprises. You will build the strategy, the team, the partnerships, and the revenue engine.

Responsibilities

Build and own the complete go-to-market strategy for Starlink Enterprise in Canada from scratch, with primary focus on large enterprise and Top Fortune accounts, followed by SLED and government
Own full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions across the Canadian market
Establish and scale strategic relationships with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations, key ecosystems, and channel partners
Build a robust multi-tier channel and partner ecosystem to accelerate market coverage and growth
Identify, develop, and close large opportunities with Canada’s top enterprises, while also pursuing high-value civil, provincial, municipal, education, and broader government opportunities as a secondary priority
Recruit, build, and lead a high-performing Canadian sales and channel team
Consistently meet and exceed revenue targets by identifying high-impact opportunities and closing complex deals
Develop, champion, and defend alternative go-to-market and partnership strategies internally
Partner closely with market access, government affairs, finance, legal, product, and engineering teams
Gather market and customer requirements and collaborate with product and engineering to shape Starlink offerings for the Canadian enterprise market
Represent Starlink at key Canadian industry, enterprise, and government conferences and events

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree
12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise sales, business development, or sales leadership (ideally with significant Canadian market experience)

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven track record of building a market, GTM strategy, and sales/channel organization from the ground up
Deep existing relationships and experience working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems
Strong expertise building and scaling robust channel and partner ecosystems
Extensive experience selling complex technology or connectivity solutions into large enterprise / Top Fortune accounts
Experience with Canadian government, provincial/municipal, and education (SLED) sectors as a secondary strength
Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and full revenue ownership of a regional business
Strong sales track record with consistent achievement of ambitious revenue targets, preferably in satellite, telecommunications, connectivity, or technology solutions
Independently motivated self-starter with exceptional ownership mentality and the ability to build structure in ambiguous environments
Outstanding interpersonal, executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills across business and technical issues
Highly detail-oriented, resilient, and results-driven with excellent customer and partner interface skills
Working knowledge of Starlink’s network infrastructure (or ability to rapidly develop it) sufficient to communicate value to sophisticated enterprise customers and partners
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex external relationships

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 50%+) across Canada to customer and partner locations, as well as to other SpaceX sites as required
Preference for candidates based in Canada or with strong willingness to relocate

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Director of Finance to lead our accounting and financial operations function. This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity of the company's financial reporting, maintaining strong internal controls, overseeing the accounting team, and supporting organizational decision-making through accurate and timely financial information.
The ideal candidate is a strong accounting leader with a hands-on approach, exceptional knowledge of financial reporting and controls, and experience managing the day-to-day finance operations of a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities
Lead all accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, fixed assets, and month-end close processes.
Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Oversee account reconciliations and ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
Maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial records across the organization.
Develop and improve accounting policies, procedures, and controls
Lead the annual financial statement audit and serve as the primary liaison with external auditors.
Ensure compliance with all applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Establish, monitor, and enhance internal control processes to safeguard company assets.
Coordinate corporate tax filings and support relations with external tax advisors.
Identify and mitigate financial and operational risks.
Support the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
Monitor actual results against budget and provide variance analysis.
Prepare management reports and financial insights to support business leaders.
Assist senior leadership with financial planning and operational decision-making
Oversee cash flow management and forecasting.
Monitor working capital and liquidity requirements.
Manage banking relationships and support financing activities.
Ensure effective controls around cash management and disbursements.
Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting and finance team.
Establish departmental goals, performance expectations, and development plans.
Foster a collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and customer service.
Drive process efficiencies and finance systems enhancements.

What you bring
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience
At least 3-5 years of experience as a Controller or in a senior accounting leadership role overseeing full-cycle accounting operations
3+ years of people leadership experience.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting standards, internal controls, and audit processes.
Experience leading month-end and year-end close functions.
Advanced Excel and financial systems proficiency.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
CPA designation preferred but not required.
Experience with SAP is an asset.
Experience implementing process improvements and finance automation initiatives

135000 - 160000 / year
